title: Hunts FH-026: Deliver merchant report and exports

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 2, Attribution. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Show visits by assurance, offers, redemption and separately authorized contacts. Suppress small cross-venue cells. Done when: Totals reconcile to claims and grants. Revoked staff and cross-Space export fail. Requires: FH-021, FH-022, FH-024, FH-025. Owner role: Analytics and web.
